LightningComponentBundle.description: A card which indicates and elaborates on how Hsu's is different from competitors.

property.label: Title
property.name: title
property.description: The title of the card which conceptualizes the difference Hsu's makes.

property.label: Message
property.name: desc
property.description: The message content of the card that elaborates on the difference Hsu's makes.

property.label: Immage Link
property.name: imageUrl
property.description: The link to the image that is displayed in the difference card.

property.label: Image Alternate Text
property.name: imageAlt
property.description: The alternate/descriptor text for the image. Displays on hover of the image and when read by screenreaders

property.label: CTA Link
property.name: ctaUrl
property.description: The link/href that the user will be navigated to when the link is clicked.

property.label: CTA Display Text
property.name: ctaText
property.description: The text that will be displayed for the clickable link.
